title: Steam Sterilization of Instrument Trays with AI-Assisted Cycle Review
status: DRAFT — illustrative, not validated or approved

scopeAndAssumptions.label: Process
scopeAndAssumptions.text: reusable surgical instrument trays moving from decontamination through steam (moist heat) sterilization to release and sterile storage.

scopeAndAssumptions.label: AI component
scopeAndAssumptions.text: Sterile Sense AI is assumed to review sterilizer cycle records (parameters and printouts) and suggest a pass or flag to a human reviewer. A human makes the release decision. This describes a hypothetical use for analysis, not a statement of current product capability.

scopeAndAssumptions.label: Equipment
scopeAndAssumptions.text: pre-vacuum steam sterilizers with routine air-removal and leak testing.

scopeAndAssumptions.label: Out of scope
scopeAndAssumptions.text: point-of-use handling in the OR, transport between facilities, and low-temperature sterilization methods.

scopeAndAssumptions.label: Framework
scopeAndAssumptions.text: structure follows the general approach of ICH Q9(R1), Quality Risk Management. Moist heat sterilization practice is covered by standards such as ISO 17665.

processSteps.name: Review the cycle record with AI assistance (Sterile Sense AI plus a human reviewer)

failureModes.failureMode: Residual soil or bioburden left on instruments
failureModes.effect: Steam can't reach the surface, so the instrument may not be sterile
failureModes.preventionControls: Defined cleaning SOPs; washer cycles; staff training
failureModes.detectionControls: Visual inspection; periodic cleaning verification tests

failureModes.failureMode: Damaged or missing instrument in tray
failureModes.effect: Surgical delay; possible use of a defective instrument

failureModes.failureMode: Torn wrap or failed pouch seal
failureModes.detectionControls: Visual check at release and before use

failureModes.failureMode: Overloaded chamber or incorrect load placement
failureModes.effect: Poor steam penetration and cold spots, so the load may not be fully sterilized

failureModes.failureMode: Air removal failure or chamber air leak
failureModes.cause: Vacuum pump wear; door gasket leak
failureModes.detectionControls: Daily air-removal (Bowie-Dick type) test; leak rate test

failureModes.failureMode: Wrong cycle selected for the load

failureModes.effect: Chamber reads in range while actual conditions are not

failureModes.stepName: Review the cycle record with AI assistance (Sterile Sense AI plus a human reviewer)
failureModes.failureMode: AI marks a failed cycle as pass (false negative)
failureModes.effect: Non-sterile load may be released if the human misses it too
failureModes.cause: Training data lacks rare failure patterns; unfamiliar equipment
failureModes.preventionControls: Human sign-off required; defined intended use
failureModes.detectionControls: Periodic human re-review of a sample

failureModes.stepName: Review the cycle record with AI assistance (Sterile Sense AI plus a human reviewer)
failureModes.failureMode: Model drift after an equipment, firmware, or printout format change
failureModes.cause: Input data changes that change control doesn't cover

failureModes.failureMode: Reviewer over-relies on the AI and rubber-stamps "pass"
failureModes.effect: The human check stops working as an independent control

failureModes.stepName: Review the cycle record with AI assistance (Sterile Sense AI plus a human reviewer)
failureModes.failureMode: Too many false flags on good cycles

failureModes.stepName: Review the cycle record with AI assistance (Sterile Sense AI plus a human reviewer)
failureModes.failureMode: Incomplete audit trail (model version, inputs, overrides)
failureModes.effect: Release decision can't be reconstructed; data integrity gap
failureModes.cause: Logging not designed for AI decisions

failureModes.failureMode: Load released before all release criteria are met
Wet packs or poor storage conditions
failureModes.effect: Moisture can wick contamination through the barrier
failureModes.preventionControls: Dry phase in cycle; storage environment controls

recommendedActions.action: Add routine cleaning verification at a defined frequency, plus magnified inspection for complex or lumened instruments
Standardize packaging materials; add a barrier integrity check to the point-of-use checklist
Post visual load pattern guides at each sterilizer; require supervisor sign-off for non-standard loads
Trend air removal and leak test results; set PM intervals from the trends
Restrict cycle menus by load type; use barcode mapping from load to cycle
Lock out sterilizers with overdue calibration; compare against independent reference monitoring
Evaluate the model on a test set enriched with known failed cycles against predefined acceptance criteria; keep mandatory human review of every release
Bring equipment, firmware, and printout format changes under change control so they trigger model re-evaluation; monitor AI–human agreement rates
Have reviewers check key parameters before the AI verdict is shown ("blind-first" review); audit a sample of reviews
Log model version, inputs, outputs, reviewer ID, timestamps, and overrides in a tamper-evident audit trail
Have the system enforce hold status until all release criteria are met; require a QA second signature for any override

topRisksSummary.label: Reviewers trusting the AI too much (RPN 270)
topRisksSummary.text: If people stop checking because the AI said "pass," the human safety net is gone. This is the biggest risk because it undermines every other AI-related control.

topRisksSummary.label: Dirty instruments going into the sterilizer (RPN 240)
topRisksSummary.text: Sterilization can't make up for poor cleaning, and residual soil is hard to see.

topRisksSummary.label: Model drift after equipment or format changes (RPN 192)
topRisksSummary.text: The AI can quietly get worse when its inputs change, unless changes trigger re-evaluation.

topRisksSummary.label: Bad load configuration (RPN 160)
topRisksSummary.text: Overloaded or badly arranged loads can block steam, even when the cycle itself runs correctly.

topRisksSummary.label: AI passing a failed cycle (RPN 150)
topRisksSummary.text: This is rare but severe. Testing on known failure cases and mandatory human review are the main defenses.
